data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 12.419m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded an overall prior-year surplus of GBP 1.2m (a release), which the report says was primarily driven by better than expected claims experience in the casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes. No gross prior-year movement figure is provided; the GBP 1.2m figure is presented in the notes as an overall surplus (net of reinsurance).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, gross) at 31 Dec 2014. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure is provided in the notes; the note text explicitly states an "overall surplus of GBP 1.2m on prior year reserves" (this is a NET statement). The prior-year movement used is therefore the reported net surplus (-1.2m) because no gross prior-year movement (Insurance liabilities column) is separately disclosed. Claims development information is limited: a small gross claims development summary is provided for 2014 and 2015 only. Named 'events' in the report appear in a catastrophe exposure table (hypothetical estimated losses) rather than as actual incurred losses.
